<!--
		// 상단 탑메뉴 
		$(function(){
		  $("#h_mline ul li a").mouseover(function(){
			$("#h_smenu").slideDown("fast");    
		  });
		  $("#h_mline").mouseleave(function(){
			closeMenu();
		  });
	
		  $("#h_mline ul li a").focusin(function(){
			$("#h_smenu").slideDown("fast");    
		  });
		});
	
		// 상단 메뉴 닫기
		function closeMenu(){
		  $("#h_smenu").slideUp("fast");
		}
	
		$(document).ready(function(){
			$(".m_menu a, .mclose").click(function(){
				//$("#mobile_menu:not(:animated)").toggle("fast");
				$("#mobile_menu:not(:animated)").toggle(50);
				
				return false;
			});
			
			$("#h_smenu .hsm_box > li").on("mouseover focusin", function(){
				var onMouseIndex = $("#h_smenu .hsm_box > li").index(this); //2차 메뉴의 0번째 li는 닫기 버튼임
				$("#h_mline .hm_wrap li:nth-child("+onMouseIndex+")").addClass("on");
			});
			
			$("#h_smenu .hsm_box > li").on("mouseleave focusout", function(){
				$("#h_mline .hm_wrap li").removeClass("on");
				
				var curMenuIndex = "2";
				curMenuIndex = curMenuIndex * 1;
				
				$("#h_mline .hm_wrap li:nth-child("+curMenuIndex+")").addClass("on");
			});
		});
		
		//상단 1차메뉴 클릭 이벤트
		function goSecMenu(idx){
			var goPage = $("#h_smenu > .hsm_box > .m" + idx + " > ul > li:nth-child(1) > a").attr("href");
			location.href = goPage;
		}
	//-->
